title_zh: 非 AI 优先公共服务与同任务等价合同
title_en: Non-AI-First Public Service and Same-Task Parity Contract
purpose_zh: 把非 AI 从备用说明升级为公共空间与服务的第一类基础设施：公众可先用纸面、口头、实体导视或人工路径完成基本任务，再自愿选择 AI。
purpose_en: Make non-AI a first-class public-space and service infrastructure: people can complete the basic task first through paper, oral, physical-wayfinding, or staffed routes, and may then choose AI voluntarily.

permanent_public_rights.service_rule: Entry, orientation, the basic task, complaint, and exit may not depend on registration, a QR code, a smartphone, or a personal device.
Paper, oral, physical-wayfinding, or staffed channels must reach the same essential outcome, not merely advertise that an alternative exists.
The ordinary route and service sequence must remain continuous by design; survey, co-testing, and professional compliance evidence are still required.
Whenever a service is offered, a visible staffed or callable human route must receive, explain, refuse safely, or hand off the same basic task; exact operator and window remain unknown.
Participation and data use are voluntary and separable from passage or basic service; withdrawal may be made orally, on paper, or through staff without using AI.
Complaint, evidence supplement, correction, suspension request, status query, and review enter the same accountable queue regardless of channel.
A screen-free waiting and information option remains available; sound, light, queueing, and event kit yield to ordinary movement, rest, and the declared quiet baseline.

common_entry.zh: 从既有入口进入连续日常轨，先看实体权利图例；不注册、不扫码、不被默认采集。
common_entry.en: Enter the continuous civic track through an existing entry and read the physical rights legend first; no registration, QR scan, or default collection.

service_blueprint.parity_merge_rule: Both lanes must reach the same essential outcome, eligibility, cost rule, rights, accountable queue, and recovery route. Interface identity is not required.
stop_and_recovery: stop the automated layer when a hard failure signal appears
keep ordinary passage and the non-AI task available or safely refuse and hand off
record complaint, withdrawal, correction, and affected evidence through a human-owned queue
remove temporary sound, light, queue, screen, equipment, and collection state
independent retest and place-restoration check before any restart discussion

parity_dimensions.test_zh: 未来服务窗口内，非 AI 路径与 AI 路径同时可进入；当前窗口与人员未知。
parity_dimensions.test_en: In any future service window, the non-AI and AI paths are simultaneously enterable; the current window and personnel are unknown.

parity_dimensions.test_zh: 完成同一基本任务、取得同一资格或进入同一后续流程。
parity_dimensions.test_en: Complete the same basic task, receive the same eligibility, or enter the same next process.

parity_dimensions.test_zh: 不得因不用账户、设备或算法而增加费用。
parity_dimensions.test_en: No higher charge for not using an account, device, or algorithm.

parity_dimensions.test_zh: 知情、撤回、申诉、纠正、暂停、状态查询和复核进入同一责任队列。
parity_dimensions.test_en: Notice, withdrawal, appeal, correction, suspension, status query, and review enter the same accountable queue.

parity_dimensions.test_zh: 安全、无障碍意图、隐私和有尊严的等待不得更弱。
parity_dimensions.test_en: Safety, accessibility intent, privacy, and dignified waiting may not be weaker.

parity_dimensions.test_zh: 分别记录完成、放弃、交接、等待和补件；阈值须现场基线后预注册。
parity_dimensions.test_en: Record completion, abandonment, handoff, waiting, and extra steps separately; thresholds follow a field baseline and preregistration.

place_service_contracts.hard_stop: equipment boundary breach, collision, inaccessible detour, nuisance, or failed staffed takeover
place_service_contracts.recovery: isolate equipment; keep the ordinary route; remove equipment, cable, enclosure, sound, light, and queue; independently recheck path and place

place_service_contracts.hard_stop: withdrawal not honoured, safeguarding gap, material group disparity, amplified nuisance, or quiet-baseline failure
place_service_contracts.recovery: stop collection and matching; retain paper and staffed service; remove screen, sound, event kit, and temporary marks; restore resident daily use

place_service_contracts.hard_stop: stale or conflicting source, diagnosis-like output, failed handoff, blocked commute, or unequal complaint route
place_service_contracts.recovery: take the automated layer offline; keep staffed and source-list service; correct the source and queue; clear event kit; retest all four movement arms

group_acceptance.acceptance_task: find the right, ask orally, wait without a screen, complete the basic task, correct or withdraw, and leave without an account
group_acceptance.denominator: all consented same-task attempts by this group in a future preregistered window

group_acceptance.group_zh: 残障人士与行动不便者
group_acceptance.group_en: disabled people and people with reduced mobility
group_acceptance.acceptance_task: complete the same route and service sequence with the required communication or mobility support and no activity obstruction
group_acceptance.denominator: all consented same-task attempts by this group in a future preregistered window

group_acceptance.acceptance_task: identify the non-AI choice without prompting, understand the next step, complete it, query status, and seek correction
group_acceptance.denominator: all consented same-task attempts by this group in a future preregistered window

group_acceptance.group_zh: 无账户或无智能设备使用者
group_acceptance.group_en: people without an account or smart device
group_acceptance.acceptance_task: enter, complete the basic task, receive a durable status reference, appeal or withdraw, and leave without borrowing or creating a device or account
group_acceptance.denominator: all consented same-task attempts without an account or smart device in a future preregistered window
group_acceptance.threshold: zero_account_or_qr_dependency_is_a_design_hard_rule; all performance thresholds remain unknown pending field preregistration

test_journeys.service_zh: 进入、导引与无障碍意图路径
test_journeys.non_ai_path: physical rights legend, tactile/paper map, physical signs, and staffed assistance
test_journeys.ai_path: optional sourced route suggestion after disclosure and voluntary choice
test_journeys.essential_outcome: reach the same destination or receive the same safe refusal and staffed handoff
test_journeys.exit_action: stop AI route advice, retain physical guidance and staffed checking, and restore only after route and information parity are independently retested

test_journeys.service_zh: 来源化企业与公共事项导航
test_journeys.non_ai_path: dual-entry staffed desk, telephone, and dated paper source list
test_journeys.essential_outcome: receive the same verifiable official source and next formal service entry without implying approval
test_journeys.exit_action: take automated navigation offline and retain staffed and source-list service until source, queue, and correction parity pass independent retest

test_journeys.non_ai_path: screen-free waiting, oral or paper participation, staffed explanation, and oral or paper withdrawal
test_journeys.ai_path: optional bounded learning tool after separate consent
test_journeys.essential_outcome: learn or contribute without weaker participation, withdrawal, or safeguarding rights
test_journeys.exit_action: stop collection and matching, keep staffed and paper learning, remove digital and event overlays, and restore resident daily use

test_journeys.non_ai_path: oral, telephone, paper, or staffed intake with a durable non-digital reference
test_journeys.essential_outcome: enter the same accountable queue with the same status, evidence, correction, suspension, and review rights
test_journeys.exit_action: stop automated routing and use human registration and assignment until the cross-channel queue audit passes

test_journeys.service_zh: 社区健康信息与人工转介
test_journeys.service_en: community health information and staffed referral
test_journeys.non_ai_path: staffed consultation, telephone, and a physical verified-provider list
test_journeys.essential_outcome: receive the same non-diagnostic information, verified provider entry, and urgent referral
test_journeys.exit_action: stop AI output and retain staffed and authoritative-provider information until boundary and entry parity are retested

test_journeys.service_zh: 停止、人工接管与场所恢复
test_journeys.service_en: stop, staffed takeover, and place recovery
test_journeys.non_ai_path: physical stop state, staffed explanation, ordinary detour, paper complaint, and non-technical exit
test_journeys.ai_path: automated layer stops and provides no continuation privilege
test_journeys.essential_outcome: ordinary passage and rights remain, or a safe refusal and accountable handoff occur, until independent retest and place restoration close
test_journeys.exit_action: remain stopped or retire the overlay; do not restart on documentation completeness alone

acceptance_logic.field_pass_rule: No field PASS can be issued until an accountable operator, approved site and window, qualified accessibility review, consented group sample, baseline, thresholds, staffed route, evidence owner, and independent retester are confirmed and the preregistered comparison is executed.
